const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
root=/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation
manifest=.ai/task/repair-w43-20260927/PACK-MANIFEST.json
count=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r src rel expected bytes; do
  actual=$(sha256sum "$src" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  size=$(stat -c %s "$src")
  test "$actual" = "$expected"
  test "$size" = "$bytes"
  dst="evidence/quality/repair-window-43-20260927/orchestration/$rel"
  if test -e "$dst" && ! cmp -s "$src" "$dst"; then
    echo "CONFLICT $dst"
    exit 41
  fi
  count=$((count+1))
done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source,.relative_destination,.sha256,(.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest")
echo "manifest_sources_ok=$count"
find evidence/quality/repair-window-43-20260927 -type f -print | sort
for src in .ai/task/repair-w43-20260927/PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md .ai/task/repair-w43-20260927/CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json .ai/task/repair-w43-20260927/MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json .ai/task/repair-w43-20260927/TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json .ai/task/repair-w43-20260927/HOST-NOTES.md .ai/task/repair-w43-20260927/ADJUDICATION-*.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window43-20260927-publish-chain.log .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window43-20260927-publish-chain-timing.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window43-20260927-migration.json .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window43-20260927-migration-timing.json; do test -f "$src" || { echo "MISSING $src"; exit 42; }; done
echo publication_sources_ok
find .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window43-20260927-candidate-catalog -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 10000,
  max_output_tokens: 20000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "是否允许我逐项核对 PACK-MANIFEST 源文件哈希、大小和目标冲突，并确认发布附件齐全？这是写入前的只读完整性检查。"
});
text(r.output);

+各轮裁决见 `publication/ADJUDICATION-*.json`：execute-01 修复 25 条 → REVIEW(0) r0a1（GPT-6 Sol）25/25 OK → FINAL(0) f0a2（Opus 5.5）25/25 OK，cycle 0 收敛（max_cycles 5）。r0a1 原生工具审计中 2 处 `rm ` 模式命中为只读 sed 说明文字里 “confirm ” 的子串，非命令。

+## 门禁与标识
+
+门禁 17/17 全过，含严格构建；DONE_VERIFIED；全部 reviewer 与 executor 已归档。

+- 译文提交：`fbc29d590362a73b946e70dee78489d2088911ab`
+- 新 catalog：`dc90e6baa755d8ab3785318d9357ceabad07b3d4a6073de2962b0a87f21d80bf`
+- migration：`be5eb8a9ad03621b7d23e9bec7816b8ab3f2fecea4d239f67e8ae4d2afde055b`
+

+
+25 个 successor 必须重新审核，不继承旧 done。待用户审阅第32–37项不变。
+
+本 publication child 待宿主归档。
*** End Patch";
